headline: Marvell Technology Nears Acquisition Deal for Lumentum Holdings
summary: Marvell Technology is reportedly close to acquiring Lumentum Holdings. Lumentum shares rose 5.5% in premarket trading as investors reacted to the potential combination.
why: Corporate mergers and acquisitions can alter competitive landscapes, drive strategic synergies, and yield significant premiums for target company shareholders.

impacts.name: Lumentum Holdings Inc
impacts.why: News of a potential buyout drives up the target company's share price as investors price in an acquisition premium.

why_moved: Premarket share prices surged following reports of an impending buyout, reflecting acquisition speculation.
